chunks.title: CLO Releases zFab Fabric Measurement Kit: Revolutionary AI-Driven Fabric Digitization System + Booking Website Introduction
chunks.content: ## Introduction to the Clos Z-Fab Fabric Measurement Kit This section introduces the Clos Z-Fab Kit, a new AI-driven fabric digitization system designed to enhance fabric measurement and scanning workflows. It highlights the development journey, user feedback, and the core motivation behind the product release. Kay, Head of Research at Closoal, along with Mason and Justin, 3D Design and Implementation Specialists, present the Clos Z-Fab Kit. This new release follows extensive user feedback emphasizing the need for improved service quality, better training, and support. Users expressed challenges with existing hardware, particularly the difficulty of manual measurements, susceptibility to user error, and the high cost of current texture scanning options. The Clos team designed the Z-Fab Kit to address these issues by minimizing human error in measurements and integrating the solution smoothly into the Clos ecosystem, ensuring affordability and ease of use. --- ## Components of the Clos Z-Fab Kit This section details the three main devices of the Clos Z-Fab Kit: the Z-Fab Cutter, Z-Fab Draper, and Z-Fab Scanner. It explains their individual functions and how they contribute to more accurate, faster fabric measurement and scanning. ### Z-Fab Cutter The Z-Fab Cutter is engineered to produce uniform fabric samples efficiently. It replaces small scissors, eliminating the struggle and inconsistency associated with manual cutting. This ensures every fabric sample is cut precisely the same size, improving reliability in subsequent measurement steps. ### Z-Fab Draper The Z-Fab Draper leverages deep learning AI to automate and simplify fabric measurement processes. This device accelerates the analysis of fabric properties while enhancing accuracy, reducing the time spent on manual measurement and mitigating errors caused by user variability. ### Z-Fab Scanner Clos’ proprietary Z-Fab Scanner is an affordable fabric texture scanner fully integrated with Clos software. It streamlines texture scanning, making it easier, faster, and more seamless for clients to capture high-quality fabric textures within the Clos ecosystem. --- ## Deployment and Availability This section covers the rollout plans, target customers, and the company’s commitment to ongoing support and improvements. The Clos Z-Fab Kit is scheduled for release in Q4 of the year, primarily targeting enterprise clients and educational institutions. Interested parties are encouraged to contact their regional Clos representatives for early access. Clos commits to maintaining high standards of user support, training, and service quality alongside the new hardware release. The company values ongoing user feedback to continue refining and enhancing the Z-Fab Kit’s capabilities, aiming to improve workflow efficiency and ease of use. --- ## Summary The Clos Z-Fab Fabric Measurement Kit represents a significant advancement in fabric digitization, combining AI-driven automation with precise hardware components. By addressing user pain points such as manual measurement errors, cutting inconsistencies, and expensive scanning equipment, the Z-Fab Kit offers a comprehensive, integrated solution designed to accelerate and improve fabric analysis workflows within the Clos ecosystem.
